verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships a first-party, browser-based visual Editor with drag-and-drop scene building, a viewport and live editing of materials and positions. Community users independently describe it as coming with a nice scene editor, so the core of the story is delivered. However, prefabs/templates and an inspector panel are never explicitly documented in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented prefab/template system, explicit inspector/property-panel documentation, hands-on evidence of level-building workflows at scale.

support.subject: As a technical artist, a full visual editor — viewport, inspector, prefabs/scene composition — is the primary way to build levels

citations.quote: Want drag-and-drop scene building, real-time collaboration, or prefer visual tools over code
The PlayCanvas Editor is a powerful, browser-based development environment for creating stunning 3D applications.
With live editing, you can tweak materials, adjust positions, and even modify scripts while your application runs.
It can modify project data and verify the result through the viewport or a running application.
pretty lightweight, but still comes with a nice scene editor etc.
